findings.problem: The bare prompt "light" can also be read as an adjective, for weight (ligero) or colour (claro), and nothing rules those readings out.
findings.fix: hint: noun, as in turn on the light

back.es: the light (noun); also, colloquially, electricity or power

note: Luz also commonly means electricity in Latin America (se fue la luz), which a later example could show, but this card's meaning is fine as written.
